Subject: Resale certificate for drop-ship SKUs

Hi Soojin,

We're getting ready to finalize the first committed purchase order (PO# 7102) with Redwood and want to confirm tax handling for drop-ship orders. Shoreline will be the reseller to the end customer, but in many states we ship directly to their customer via our warehouse partner.

Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept Shoreline's resale certificate that lists Shoreline as the purchaser when Redwood is the ship-from vendor (drop-ship), or do you need the certificate to name the end-customer in certain states? Also: are there any states where Redwood requires us to register or provide additional documentation for exemption to apply?

We can provide an executed resale cert (PDF) and our EIN if that helps. I attached the signed certificate for your review.

Thanks — Bethany
Bethany Cole

Hi Bethany — thanks for sending the signed certificate and for the clear summary. Short answer: yes, in most states we can accept Shoreline's resale certificate that names Shoreline as the purchaser for drop-ship transactions, provided the certificate meets the state's form requirements and includes Shoreline's EIN and signature.

A few important notes and requests so we can validate and record this without holding up the PO: 
- Please confirm the ship-from address Redwood will use on invoices (we need to compare it to our nexus list).
- For California and a handful of states on our nexus list, state rules can require either registration or additional affidavit language — if Shoreline expects heavy volume to end customers in CA, please let us know so we can confirm whether Redwood needs any supplementary documentation.
- We validate certificates by: (1) confirming purchaser name/EIN/signature present; (2) checking format against state guidance; (3) saving the PDF to our secure finance bucket and linking the HubSpot deal; (4) noting expiration (if any) and setting a reminder 90 days before it lapses.

Next steps I'm initiating today:
- I uploaded the attached PDF to our finance folder and started a quick format review. Preliminary pass looks OK but I need the ship-from address before final acceptance.
- I'll create a DocuSign envelope if any language edits are needed for state-specific requirements (this only happens for a small subset of customers).

If you can reply with the Redwood ship-from address you expect on POs (or if you prefer we use the warehouse address that will actually ship the goods), we'll finalize. If it's easier, we can sign a short attestation that Shoreline is the purchaser for resale purposes — I've included a one-click DocuSign link below.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abc123

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

We mostly expect low-volume shipments to CA right now but will flag if that changes. I clicked the DocuSign link and completed the attestation just now — you should see the executed copy on your side. Let me know if you need anything else.
